verdict.rationale: telli's docs say audio recording can be made conditional on the caller's consent, so each call is recorded only after the caller agrees. A separate data-retention feature automatically deletes contacts and call data once they reach an age you define. Both core parts of the story are covered, but each rests on a single short doc line. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of disclosure messaging (the EU AI Act transparency page is only implied as covering it), details on manual per-call recording toggles and retention granularity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
